description.en: The owner must know right away.
description.zh-CN: 必须马上知道

description.en: Work stops until the owner acts.
description.zh-CN: 主人不动，事情就停在那里

description.en: Something the owner started has a result: worth knowing, nothing to do.
description.zh-CN: 主人自己发起的事有了结果；值得知道，不必处理

description.en: Everything else: agent-to-agent work and cutex's own housekeeping. Timeline only.
description.zh-CN: 其它一切：智能体之间的工作、系统自己的运转；只在时间线

description.en: Needs-you strip, sidebar, tray / taskbar badge and the phone's needs-you list.
description.zh-CN: 需要你条、侧栏、托盘 / 任务栏角标和手机的需要你列表

description.en: A done / failed mark on the agent, cleared when it is opened; not counted.
description.zh-CN: 「完成」/「出错」小标记，打开智能体即清；不计数

description.en: OS notification on the desktop.
description.zh-CN: 系统通知

description.en: Push to the phone and the webhook.
description.zh-CN: 推送到手机和 webhook

description.en: Play a sound with the notification / alert window.
description.zh-CN: 通知 / 置顶提醒窗弹出时响铃

description.en: Always-on-top alert window and taskbar flash.
description.zh-CN: 置顶提醒窗 + 任务栏闪烁

description.en: Only the owner's own work can need the owner.
description.zh-CN: 只有主人自己的事才可能需要主人

description.en: A message an agent sent the owner at level Inform.
description.zh-CN: 智能体发给主人、级别为告知的消息

title.zh-CN: 智能体消息 · 需要你

description.en: A message an agent sent the owner at level Needs you (also urgent ones over the hourly urgent limit).
description.zh-CN: 智能体发给主人、级别为需要你的消息（含超过每小时紧急条数被降级的）

description.en: A message an agent sent the owner at level Urgent.
description.zh-CN: 智能体发给主人、级别为紧急的消息

title.en: Agent message · Asks for a reply
title.zh-CN: 智能体消息 · 需要回复

description.en: A message that asks the owner for a reply. The higher of this and its level event wins; it stays in Needs you until answered.
description.zh-CN: 要主人回复的智能体消息；和按级别的事件取较高的级别，回复之前一直在需要你里

title.en: Agent message · Over the hourly limit
title.zh-CN: 智能体消息 · 超过条数限制

description.en: A message beyond the hourly limit per agent; replaces its level event. Agents set to Always deliver are not limited.
description.zh-CN: 超过每小时条数的智能体消息，代替按级别的事件；设为强制送达的智能体不受限

description.en: A message between agents could not be delivered and was quarantined.
description.zh-CN: 智能体之间的消息投递不了，被隔离

description.en: A delegation or its results could not reach the other agent.
description.zh-CN: 委托或委托结果到不了对方

description.en: An open delegation has not changed for days.
description.zh-CN: 未关闭的委托很多天没有变化

description.en: Under full access, a Claude Code safety check declined a command; the owner may approve one exact retry.
description.zh-CN: 完全访问下，Claude Code 的安全检查拦下了一条命令；主人可以批准一次原样重试

description.en: A cutex notice without a more specific kind.
description.zh-CN: 没有更具体类别的 cutex 通知

description.en: Approval for a command, file change or permission (also from subagents).
description.zh-CN: 命令、文件改动或权限的审批（含子智能体）

description.en: The agent asks a question or for input.
description.zh-CN: 智能体提问或请你填写信息

description.en: An owner approval waiting for the owner.
description.zh-CN: 等主人处理的审批

description.en: A delegation's question was routed to the owner (any requester).
description.zh-CN: 委托里的问题转给了主人（不论谁发起）

title.en: Delegation waiting for the owner's review

description.en: The delegation waits for the owner's review (any requester).
description.zh-CN: 委托等主人审阅后才能继续（不论谁发起）

description.en: Interrupted with an unknown outcome; the owner asked.
description.zh-CN: 中断且结果未知；主人发起

title.zh-CN: 智能体的委托：结果未知

description.en: Interrupted with an unknown outcome; an agent asked (it handles it).
description.zh-CN: 中断且结果未知；智能体发起（由发起方处理）

description.en: Answered and awaiting the owner's acceptance.
description.zh-CN: 已回答，等主人验收

description.en: Answered and awaiting the requesting agent's acceptance.
description.zh-CN: 已回答，等发起方智能体验收

description.en: Failed, rejected or cancelled and not closed; the owner asked.
description.zh-CN: 失败 / 拒绝 / 取消且未关闭；主人发起

description.en: Failed / rejected / cancelled; an agent asked.
description.zh-CN: 失败 / 拒绝 / 取消；智能体发起

description.en: Sending a delegation failed; the error shows above the composer.
description.zh-CN: 发出委托时出错，错误显示在输入框上方

description.en: A message between agents failed to send; marked failed in the messages panel.
description.zh-CN: 智能体之间的消息发送失败，消息面板里标「失败」

description.en: A turn the owner started completed while the owner was not looking at the agent.
description.zh-CN: 主人发起的回合完成，当时主人没在看这个智能体

description.en: A turn the owner started failed.
description.zh-CN: 主人发起的回合失败

description.en: The owner pressed stop.
description.zh-CN: 主人按了停止

description.en: A turn started by a delegation, an agent message or cutex itself completed.
description.zh-CN: 委托 / 智能体消息 / 系统唤醒的回合完成

description.en: A turn started by a delegation, an agent message or cutex itself failed or was interrupted.
description.zh-CN: 委托 / 智能体消息 / 系统唤醒的回合失败或中断

title.en: Runtime crashed during the owner's turn
title.zh-CN: 主人回合中运行时崩溃

description.en: The runtime failed while a turn the owner started was running.
description.zh-CN: 主人发起的回合进行中运行时出错

description.en: The runtime failed outside the owner's turns.
description.zh-CN: 不在主人回合中的运行时出错

description.en: A job the owner submitted finished.
description.zh-CN: 主人提交的作业结束

title.zh-CN: 智能体提交的作业结束

description.en: A job an agent submitted finished (it also wakes the agent).
description.zh-CN: 智能体提交的作业结束（同时唤醒智能体）
